atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Declares design tokens (colors, fonts, radius, etc.) that become utility classes such as `bg-primary`.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Adds a source for Tailwind to scan for class names that automatic detection misses.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Creates a custom utility class that works with variants like `hover:` and `md:`.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant inside CSS, e.g. `@variant dark { ... }`.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Declares a custom variant, e.g. a `dark:` variant tied to a `.dark` class.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines utility classes into a regular CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Imports another stylesheet's theme and utilities for use in this file without adding its CSS to the output.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript config file (for migrating from Tailwind v3).

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Loads a legacy JavaScript plugin (for migrating from Tailwind v3).
